svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.06k stars in total, about 1.71k a year earlier. jactionlint 302, mr boxington 643, aube 2058, fnox 2342, hk 1294, pitchfork 700, usage 1067, +5 more 654.
